headline: Executive:   Strategic  |  Commercial  |  People-Focussed
summary: A purpose-driven, strategic and commercial executive who is passionate about leading cross-functional teams and together, delivering outstanding results. I thrive, when I can provide clarity of thought to set the strategic direction and make it real through a customer-first approach backed by whole of company engagement and deep business insights. Leveraging comprehensive experience in strategy consulting, product management, and customer experience, I bring agility, commercial acumen and results leadership. I believe in the power of leading by example and develop teams to genuinely collaborate, continuously cultivate their strengths, and have a determined can-do attitude.

positions.title: Executive Manager Inclusive Products
positions.description:
I am accountable for creating inclusive products and propositions for digitally excluded people, for people with disability, and people in vulnerable circumstances.
I set up and now lead nbn's Low-Income and Digital Inclusion Forum (LIDIF), an active industry collaboration across telecommunications industry, not-for-profit organisations, customer advocacy groups as well as federal and state government agencies to lower access, affordability, and digital ability barriers for digitally excluded people in Australia.
I also bring together the cross-company work towards making nbn's products and services more accessible and inclusive for people with disability - how nbn listens, how nbn communicates, and how nbn shapes its products.

positions.title: Principal Fixed Broadband Network Experience
positions.description:
Led the P&L for nbn network payments to achieve cost targets whilst delivering market leading nbn broadband speed experiences ; established a brand-new function accountable for setting, monitoring & improving customer experience while using the fixed broadband networks end-to end; enabled Chief Marketing Office to translate Telstra‘s investment in experience superiority into clear & concise marketing messages; ensured end-to-end operational processes, channel information as well as customer communication & remediation are compliant with ACCC mandate; member of the Connected Home & Business Leadership team, leading up to 10 multidisciplinary direct reports through largest transformation at Telstra and while introducing Agile

Key Achievements
 Managed in excess of $1B nbnTM network lease payments; identified & executed major, cross-company cost savings initiatives generating in excess of $50M in savings, regularly presenting to Group Executives on portfolio and initiative performance

 Piloted a Telstra-first, big data-enabled capability to measure end-to-end fixed-line customer network experience metrics; the capability uncovered underperformance in a supplier-provided part of the network, inter-company collaboration led to improvement of busy hour speeds for up to 75% of customers

Established tight, regular collaboration &  aligned incentives between Product and Network teams to achieve winning position in the Netflix ISP Speed Index for 10+ months and highlighted this differentiation in digital and digital out-of-home marketing

 Attained compliance with ACCC’s industry guidance on broadband speed claims by creating automated customer communication on actual speed performance, credit application & remediation

 In Telstra’s enterprise-wide Agile transformation, established cross-functional team, co-created the team mission, intimately involved in shaping the Agile launch event & ultimately embedding comprehensive set of new work practices into daily routines

positions.title: General Manager Strategy & Operations Postpaid Mobiles
positions.description:
Developed, refined & helped to implement the overall strategy for the Consumer Postpaid Mobiles business; developed, monitored & tracked key KPI to deliver insights on business performance; led strategic initiatives & projects for the business incl. commercial business cases for major projects; managed mobile handset subsidy P&L and capital expenditure; member of the Consumer Postpaid Mobiles Leadership team with 4 direct reports.

Key Achievements
 Product Strategy & Executive Communication: Crafted 18-months product roadmap, managed monthly Board paper on product performance, delivered weekly commercial driver insights , individual product performance reporting

 Device Pricing for Postpaid Mobile Handheld & Mobile Broadband: Managed $500M+ postpaid device subsidy budget by setting end customer device pricing to drive weekly SIO momentum as well as succeed during major handset launches with a keen eye on competitor moves whilst balancing against restricted vendor contributions and available subsidy budget

 Device strategy: Created & achieved endorsement for device repayment playbook across all new no-lock-in contract fixed and mobile plans resulting in elimination of mobile device subsidy cost at scale

 International knowledge exchange: Initiated & ran monthly insights sessions with global peers to enable best-in-class learning opportunities for Telstra’s product managers

 Lease Device Return Optimisation: Initiated, managed & delivered program to reduce customer experience & commercial risks resulting from Telstra’s handset leasing product (e.g. improved customer knowledge at Point-of Sale by 7pp, increase in customers’ device return rates)

 Capital Management: Successfully managed $10M capital to support prioritised  product and offer builds

 People Development: nurtured existing team to all achieve Telstra-internal career progression,  re-created new team & established the team as a sought-after rotation for Graduates

Social media community guidelines:

We know that many Australians will have questions and comments about the nbn® network, and we encourage feedback, commentary, and discussion that’s calm, constructive, and considerate.  

We expect that anyone wanting to share their opinion on our social channels will ensure that their comments are relevant and respectful to everyone in the community, and adhere to our community guidelines.

These guidelines assist us in identifying any comments that may need to be moderated or removed.

The types of opinions or comments that will not be tolerated within our community include content that is:

1. False, inaccurate or misleading
2. Abusive or threatening, or causes injury or harm to any person
3. Offensive or sexually explicit
4. Racist, sexist, homophobic, transphobic, hateful or discriminatory against any religion, age, ethnicity, or disability or other protected attribute. 
5. Illegal, unlawful or defamatory
6. Trolling, deliberate disruption of discussion, or posts that will not further the discussion positively
7. Consistent misrepresentation of nbn or the nbn® network
8. Information that identifies or directs abuse at an nbn personnel
9. Information that identifies another individual or discusses their personal circumstances
10. Any personal attack on the author of content, and other readers/community members
11. An infringement of any third party’s rights, including intellectual property
12. Spam
13. Solicitation
14. Any computer viruses or another potentially damaging computer program or file
15. Link baiting

nbn does not condone, endorse or approve any content posted on our social channels that violates these guidelines.
